properties.name: OBSERVED 2026-10-11: a claude.ai chat following the brainstorm skill wrote `related_to[0].to_id` on add_decision and was refused before the call ran ("not a parameter … the names there are evidence, incoming, other_design, other_id, other_name, other_type, relation"); the retry with other_id went through 483 ms later — the one refusal in a 61-call session, and the one place the surface says other_id where every edge tool says to_id
properties.source: flo2.io's connector_calls table, client Claude-User, 2026-10-11 03:01 UTC (two add_decision calls, the first refused)
properties.statement: From flo2.io's call log: at 03:01 the chat (running the brainstorm skill on reflow2's design, recording dec:idea-how-is-a-decision-that-rests-on-numbers-held-to-keeping-its-math) called add_decision with related_to items shaped {relation, to_id, evidence}; the argument check refused it listing the seven legal names; the second call, 483 ms later, used other_id and was stored. Cost: one round trip, no damage — the refusal did its job. WHY IT IS WORTH A LINE: related_to's item (RelationLinkReq) names its far end other_id / other_type / other_design because the same shape reaches into another design (cap above), while depends_on, satisfies, create_edge and the rest name theirs to_id; an agent that has just drawn edges reaches for to_id. The same shape is also what the 2026-10-10 StoryFlow root cause touched (the skills never name other_design). Not judged here whether to alias to_id → other_id on the item (an additive alias, as `id`/`node_id` are on several tools) or to leave the refusal to teach; recorded so the next report of it is a recurrence and not a first sighting. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
